collection.title: Ford C-Max C-Max MPV 2003 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford C-Max 2003 - 2010 version requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this C-Max which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
